newsitem.title: USA: TravelCenters sells $125 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: TravelCenters sells $125 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: The following 144a offering from TravelCenters of America Inc was priced on Tuesday via lead manager Chase Securities Inc, market sources said.
The company owns, operates, and franchises a large number of travel centers which provide fuel and non-fuel products to truckers and other motorists.
